text: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on May 4, 1999; its common stock trades on the NYSE under the symbol GS.
short: Goldman Sachs has been listed on the NYSE (GS) since May 1999.

source.name: Goldman Sachs investor relations
source.quote: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on May 4, 1999.

additionalSources.name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. – Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 (SEC)
additionalSources.quote: The principal market on which our common stock is traded is the NYSE under the symbol “GS.”
